quick.title: In VSCode extension, the icon next to each quick item should update based on status
quick.problem: Can't tell status at a glance from the icon - missing visual feedback
quick.done: Both the icon shape and color reflect status

finding.reason: Contains QuickItem class with getStatusIcon() method - main file to modify

quick.approach: Update getStatusIcon() in QuickItem class to return different ThemeIcon with ThemeColor based on status: in-progress gets play-circle with blue, complete gets check with green

constraints.constraint: Use VSCode ThemeIcons and ThemeColors only (directive C4)

commit.message: quick(003): In VSCode extension, the icon next to each quick item should update based on status

quick.summary: Updated getStatusIcon() in QuickItem class to use switch statement with distinct icons: pass-filled (green) for complete, play-circle (blue) for in-progress
